---主界面

---@type UI.RuaUI
self = self

local clip = Asset.Load("Audio/Music/Home", "m_sys_void_intro")
local loop_clip = Asset.Load("Audio/Music/Home", "m_sys_void_loop")

--- 视差 / Parallax.
--- move1 是远景(背景横梁竖柱), 反向小幅漂移; move2 是近景(全部按钮面板), 同向大幅移动
--- move1 is the far plane - the background beams and struts - and drifts
--- slightly against the pointer. move2 is the near plane: the menu tiles the
--- player aims at, plus the clock, the currency row and the news panel. The
--- two moving opposite ways is what sells the depth.
--- The top-left icons and the whole player plate stay still on purpose, so the
--- movement has fixed points to read against.
--- Which widgets sit under each is set by Arknights/Home/Apply Parallax Groups.
--- 近景横向幅度受右边距限制 / The near group's horizontal throw is capped by the
--- layout, not by taste: DepotTile sits about 34 units from the right edge, so
--- anything past that pushes it off screen at full deflection. The depth comes
--- from the two planes moving opposite ways - 32 out and 28 back is 60 units of
--- relative travel, far more than the old version ever managed.
---
--- 已知: 20:9 屏幕边缘会露底 / Known limitation, and it predates this effect. move1 is a
--- fixed 2400x1400 rect while the canvas is 1080*aspect wide, so the slack per side is
--- (2400 - canvasWidth)/2: 240px at 16:9, 120px at 18:9 and exactly ZERO at 20:9. The
--- 28 below then walks the backdrop 28px inside the frame on a 20:9 screen and the empty
--- scene shows at the edge. Left alone on purpose - fixing it means resizing the rect in
--- HomeUI.prefab, which is a separate change from the parallax.
local MOVE1_X = -28
local MOVE1_Y = 16
local MOVE2_X = 32
local MOVE2_Y = -26

--- 真正的透视倾斜 / A real perspective tilt, not a squash. The UI camera is a
--- perspective camera now (Camera.prefab), so rotating this group about X or Y
--- makes its far edge genuinely narrow: parallel edges converge the way a plane
--- seen from an angle does. Under the orthographic camera this used to run on,
--- the same rotation only foreshortened, which is why 2.5 degrees was invisible
--- and why raising it would only ever have flattened the group.
---
--- 符号方向 / The signs put the corner the pointer is over NEAREST to the viewer,
--- which is what looking at a plane from that corner actually does. Flipping them
--- leans the plane away instead, and reads as the UI recoiling from the finger.
--- Verified by projecting the corners through the real camera, not by eye.
---
--- 两轴不对称, 是故意的 / The two axes are deliberately NOT equal, for two separate
--- reasons that happen to point the same way.
---
--- 一是几何 / First, geometry. move2 is 1885 wide by 908 tall, and a keystone scales
--- with the half-extent perpendicular to the rotation axis. Measured near/far edge
--- difference at the SAME angle: yaw 25.5% against pitch 11.5% at 9 degrees. Turning
--- about the short axis simply has less to work with.
---
--- 二是灵敏度, 这才是主因 / Second, and this is what actually made the vertical feel
--- heavy: `current` is normalised to the screen, so the pointer crosses the full
--- height in 540px but needs 960px for the width. Vertical tilt therefore builds
--- 1.78x faster per pixel of movement. 540/960 = 0.5625 is the ratio that equalises
--- it, and -3 against 5 sits at 0.6 - close enough that both axes lean at roughly the
--- same speed as the pointer travels. Keep that ratio if you retune: raising the
--- vertical toward the horizontal is what made this feel heavy in the first place.
---
--- 别用 tan(fov/2)*sin(angle) 估这个数 / Do not estimate the percentage from
--- tan(fov/2)*sin(angle) - that gives the figure for an edge one canvas half-HEIGHT
--- out, which is not where move2's side edges are. Measure the rect's own corners.
---
--- 当前强度 / Measured at these values: horizontal 13.4%, vertical 3.7% near/far size
--- difference - a 3.6 to 1 split. Tuned by hand in Play Mode with Arknights/Home/
--- Parallax Tuner; the earlier 9 degrees read as too strong in practice.
---
--- 代价: 16:9 上贴边的 tile 会被切 / The cost, measured and accepted: at 16:9 the yaw
--- pushes the edge tiles past the screen - DepotTile 47px, OperationTile 45,
--- HeadhuntTile 41, OperatorsTile 35, AccentBottom 20 - but ONLY at 16:9 and ONLY at
--- full corner deflection; 18:9 and 20:9 measure zero. The layout has no room to
--- give: DepotTile sits ~34 units from move2's right edge and MOVE2_X already spends
--- 32 of it, so the yaw gets about 2px, and each degree costs another ~11.5px. There
--- is no safe angle here - even 2 degrees clips 24px. Lowering this only trades
--- effect for clipping; the real fix is moving those tiles inward in HomeUI.prefab,
--- a separate change. Re-measure these figures if the angles change again.
local MOVE2_TILT_X = -3
local MOVE2_TILT_Y = 5

--- 远景不倾斜 / The far plane deliberately does NOT tilt. It carries the translation
--- parallax and nothing else, so the backdrop stays a flat wall and the keystone is
--- what separates the near group from it. Tilting it too was tried and reverted.

--- 指针停一秒后归位 / Settle back to centre once the pointer has been still for a
--- second, so a screen nobody is touching stops holding a tilt. On a phone that
--- is the moment a finger lifts, where there is no pointer to follow at all.
---
--- 跟随速度也影响强度 / FOLLOW_SPEED is part of how strong this reads, not just how
--- responsive it is: a slower lerp spends less time near full deflection, so the
--- extremes are grazed rather than held. Halving it from 6 to 3 was tuned by hand
--- alongside the angles and is why they could stay as high as they are.
local IDLE_SECONDS = 1
local FOLLOW_SPEED = 3

--- 移动多少才算动过(平方像素) / How far the pointer must travel to count as moving,
--- squared, so a mouse jittering by a pixel still counts as still.
local MOVED_THRESHOLD = 4

local target = Vector2.zero
local current = Vector2.zero

local move1Base
local move2Base
local lastX = -99999
local lastY = -99999
local idle = 0

---@type Data.Player.PlayerData
local data;

function init()
    --- 记住静止位置 / The offsets below are relative to wherever the prefab rests
    --- these two, so read that once rather than assuming it is zero.
    move1Base = move1.localPosition
    move2Base = move2.localPosition
end

function update()---刷新时间 - 跟随鼠标
    time.text = DateTime.Now:ToString("yyyy/MM/dd/ HH:mm")

    local moved = false

    if screenHasMouse() then
        local pointer = Input.mousePosition
        local dx = pointer.x - lastX
        local dy = pointer.y - lastY

        if dx * dx + dy * dy > MOVED_THRESHOLD then
            lastX = pointer.x
            lastY = pointer.y

            --- 按屏幕分辨率归一化, 不是画布 / Normalise against the screen, not the
            --- canvas. The two only agree at the reference resolution; anywhere
            --- else the pointer never reached the ends of the range, which is
            --- most of why this effect used to be so hard to notice.
            target = Vector2(pointer.x / Screen.width * 2 - 1, pointer.y / Screen.height * 2 - 1)
            moved = true
        end
    end

    if moved then
        idle = 0
    else
        idle = idle + Time.deltaTime
        if idle >= IDLE_SECONDS then
            target = Vector2.zero
        end
    end

    current = Vector2.Lerp(current, target, FOLLOW_SPEED * Time.deltaTime)

    local position = move1.localPosition
    position.x = move1Base.x + current.x * MOVE1_X
    position.y = move1Base.y + current.y * MOVE1_Y
    move1.localPosition = position

    position = move2.localPosition
    position.x = move2Base.x + current.x * MOVE2_X
    position.y = move2Base.y + current.y * MOVE2_Y
    move2.localPosition = position
    move2.localRotation = Quaternion.Euler(current.y * MOVE2_TILT_X, current.x * MOVE2_TILT_Y, 0)
end

function show()
    self:BaseShow()
    SoundManager:PlayMusic(clip, false, function ()
        SoundManager:PlayMusic(loop_clip, true);
    end)
    self.canvasGroup.alpha = 0
    self:FadeIn(0.5)

    data = PlayerManager:Get()
end

function hide(destroy)
    self:FadeOut(0.5, destroy)
end

function updateView()
    playerName.text = data:GetName()
    playerLevel.text = tostring(data:GetLevel() + 1)
    expPercentage.fillAmount = data:GetExp() / data:GetMaxExp()
    reason.text = tostring(data:GetReason())
    maxReason.text = tostring(data:GetMaxReason())
    sourceStone.text = "0"
    syntheticJade.text = "0"
    dragonCoin.text = "0"

    sourceStone.text = tostring(data:GetItemAmount(0));
    syntheticJade.text = tostring(data:GetItemAmount(1));
    dragonCoin.text = tostring(data:GetItemAmount(2));
    item = data:GetItemStack(1)
end

function screenHasMouse()
    local vector3 = Input.mousePosition
    return vector3.x <= Screen.width and vector3.x > 0 and vector3.y <= Screen.height and vector3.y > 0
end
